description: Keep what conversations produce — tables, charts, answers and every attachment — in an admin-governed, encrypted store; find them again, see where each came from, reuse them in a turn, and take them out by download

tool_definition.name: TDA_Files
tool_definition.description: The user's Files — kept tables, documents, reports and uploads. 'list' finds a file by name or by what it came from; 'read' reads a kept file into this turn (a table arrives as columns and rows — and as a statement of this turn the combine step can join — a document as its text); 'save' keeps something you produced in this turn: 'content' for text you wrote (a report, a summary, a SQL script), or 'statement' to keep a query result of this turn as a CSV without repeating its rows. Never invent a file id: 'list' first.

query.description: list: words to match in the file name, its conversation or its question

name.description: read: a file name, when you have no file_id. save: the file name to keep it under, with its extension (.md, .csv, .json, .sql, .txt); the extension decides the type

content.description: save: the text to keep (Markdown, CSV, JSON, SQL, plain text)

statement.description: save: a query result of THIS turn to keep as CSV — its statement number, or 'latest' for the most recent

intensity_tooltips.medium: Use TDA_Files when the user asks to find, read or keep a file
intensity_tooltips.heavy: Offer to keep reports and results the user will want again
